claims.claim: Reserve sanctions stimulate official gold demand.
claims.reason: Official buying was large and survey respondents cited crisis risks, consistent with reserve-diversification concerns. The survey does not isolate sanctions from inflation, strategic targets or domestic production, so the singular sanctions mechanism is not established.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.title: 2024 central-bank gold survey
evidence.finding: Central banks added 1,037 tonnes in 2023 after 1,082 tonnes in 2022. Survey of 70 respondents conducted February-April 2024: 29% planned higher own gold reserves. Motives included strategic rebalancing, domestic production, crisis and inflation risk; survey intentions are not completed purchases.

framework_lessons: Keep price direction, timing and cause separate.
assessment: The explicit curve and bitcoin calls resolved favorably within their 18-month windows. Halving timing was protocol-driven and should carry little discretionary forecasting credit. Colombia remains a genuine future-horizon case; macro causal attribution and regional relative returns are not yet established.
